Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: high-resolution warehouse model image for StayWise developer README.
Create a polished logical data warehouse model diagram with precise text, generous whitespace, white background, restrained teal/navy/blue palette, flat rounded table cards, thin carefully routed connectors, no 3D, no decorative clutter. Landscape approximately 3200 x 2000 pixels.
Title: "StayWise | Warehouse model".
Subtitle: "STAYWISE_DB.ANALYTICS • Logical relationships and derived marts".
Design six source/entity cards above and a separated row of three downstream mart cards below. Center FCT_BOOKING prominently. Group the six source/entity cards under "CORE MODEL". Group three marts under "SERVING MARTS".

Six entity cards with EXACT table names and these concise fields:
1 "DIM_GUEST" near upper left:
"PK  guest_id"
"display_name"
grain badge: "1 row / guest"

2 "DIM_LISTING" near middle left:
"PK  listing_id"
"FK  rule_set_id"
"title • neighborhood"
"capacity • pets_allowed"
grain badge: "1 row / listing"

3 "POLICY_RULES" near upper right:
"PK  rule_set_id"
"allowed_pet_types • minimum_nights"
"cleaning_fee • pet_fee • service_fee"
"effective_from • effective_to"
"source_document_id"
grain badge: "1 row / policy version"

4 "FCT_BOOKING" prominent central:
"PK  booking_id"
"FK  listing_id • guest_id • rule_set_id"
"check_in • check_out • status"
"guest_count • booked_nights"
"booked_nightly_rate • booked_fees"
"booked_lodging_value"
grain badge: "1 row / reservation"

5 "FCT_BOOKING_NIGHT" near lower center-left:
"PK  booking_id + stay_date"
"FK  booking_id • listing_id"
"booked_nightly_rate"
grain badge: "1 row / occupied reservation-night"
small note: "Confirmed + completed bookings only"

6 "INT_CALENDAR_CURRENT" near lower right:
"PK  listing_id + stay_date"
"FK  listing_id"
"nightly_rate • host_blocked"
"updated_at"
grain badge: "1 row / listing-night"
small note: "Incremental MERGE"

Use solid cardinality-labelled logical relationship connectors:
DIM_GUEST (1) → FCT_BOOKING (N), labelled guest_id.
DIM_LISTING (1) → FCT_BOOKING (N), labelled listing_id.
POLICY_RULES (1) → FCT_BOOKING (N), labelled rule_set_id.
POLICY_RULES (1) → DIM_LISTING (N), labelled current rule. Route cleanly over the top.
FCT_BOOKING (1) → FCT_BOOKING_NIGHT (N), labelled booking_id.
DIM_LISTING (1) → INT_CALENDAR_CURRENT (N), labelled listing_id.
FCT_BOOKING_NIGHT also references DIM_LISTING through listing_id; its FK label is sufficient to avoid an extra crossing line.

Three mart cards in a bottom band, each with a compact explicit derivation rather than a tangle of arrows:
"MART_BOOKING_CONTEXT"
"Grain: booking_id"
"Booking + listing + guest + policy"
"Consumer: Cortex Analyst"

"MART_LISTING_DAY"
"Grain: listing_id + stay_date"
"Calendar + occupied nights"
"booking_count • is_available"
"Consumer: availability + quotes"

"MART_LISTING_PERFORMANCE"
"Grain: listing_id + month"
"Listing-day + booking + listing"
"occupancy_rate • booked_lodging_value"
"Consumer: operations dashboard"

Use a simple dashed connector down from the core-model GROUP to the serving-marts GROUP labelled "dbt transformations". The three input summaries inside mart cards specify exact lineage, so do not create extra unreadable cross-wiring. Do not suggest each core table feeds each mart.

Footer legend exact text: "PK / FK: logical keys and references   •   1 → N: one-to-many   •   Dashed arrow: derived model".
Second footer note: "Checkout is exclusive. Booked lodging value excludes fees and is not recognized revenue."
Third concise note: "Logical grain and relationships are defined by dbt models; not all are physical database constraints."

Requirements: All nine cards must appear exactly once. Accurate key names, unique grains, clear relationships, consistent typography, readable labels at 1400px width. Avoid inventing a date dimension, payment fact, review fact, physical foreign-key enforcement, or direct PDF table relationships. No educational/classroom wording, no Snowflake logo imitation, no branding beyond StayWise.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Edit target: the attached StayWise warehouse model. Preserve all nine table cards, their exact names, fields, grains, and palette. Correct the diagram for final publication:
1. Entire canvas must have a solid opaque WHITE background. No transparency, black regions, outlined text, or broken pixels. All typography must be crisp solid navy.
2. Enlarge canvas vertically as necessary for whitespace and three clearly separated readable footer lines. Footer text: "PK / FK: logical keys and references • 1 → N: one-to-many • Dashed arrow: derived models". Second line: "Checkout is exclusive. Booked lodging value excludes fees and is not recognized revenue." Third line: "Logical relationships are defined by dbt; not all are physical database constraints."
3. Reroute the DIM_LISTING to INT_CALENDAR_CURRENT connector BELOW the FCT_BOOKING_NIGHT card and its note, in a spacious blank channel, then up to bottom of INT_CALENDAR_CURRENT. Label this clean line "listing_id • 1 → N". It MUST NOT touch or run behind or through the booking-night card. Remove both segments of the original horizontal line that currently passes through the booking-night card. There is NO booking-night to calendar relationship connector.
4. The dashed "dbt transformations" connector must end on the TOP BORDER of the whole SERVING MARTS group, not on an individual mart card. The input summaries on the three mart cards specify their lineage.
Keep the other five relationships unchanged. Preserve professional flat vector-like appearance and generous spacing. High resolution landscape, clear all text at full page width.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Edit target: attached StayWise warehouse model. Keep all nine cards and every field, grain, footer, existing five solid connectors, solid white background, palette and legible typography UNCHANGED. Make exactly these corrections:
1. Subtitle must read exactly "STAYWISE_DB.ANALYTICS • Logical relationships and derived marts". The current STAYWISE.DATA.ANALYTICS text is wrong.
2. Restore one missing relationship: POLICY_RULES (1) to DIM_LISTING (N). Draw a thin navy connector exiting the TOP of POLICY_RULES, traveling LEFT in an EMPTY new horizontal channel above all six cards, then down in a blank vertical channel BETWEEN the left cards and center booking card, ending with arrowhead on right edge of DIM_LISTING near its header. Label the top horizontal segment "current rule • 1 → N". Increase height of the core-model panel and lower cards slightly to give this connector space. It must not cross any card or its text. Other connectors remain unchanged.
3. Shorten the dashed dbt transformations arrow so its tip ends at the top border of the SERVING MARTS group, not near the central mart card. Keep its label.
No other edits. Do not remove any existing field or connector. Clean opaque white canvas, sharp print-quality type.
